conditions_and_qualifications: Aspect = whole-sign graha drishti (Jupiter 5/7/9, Saturn 3/7/10, Rahu 7 - project convention; Rahu's 7th falls on Ketu's sign); conjunction = same sign. Venus and Mercury can only conjoin the Sun (they never get far enough to aspect it).

Conflict: TA p.154 S34 A3 and the 2026 document's gold-bullish #2 make the Sun in Libra with/aspected by malefics (Saturn, Mars, Rahu) BULLISH for gold, and TA S34 A10 says a malefic aspect makes the Sun's rally stars MORE bullish; TA S34 B1 makes a benefic with the Sun on Anuradha bearish. Both sources are shown.
Mercury is never more than ~28 deg from the Sun, so it shares the Sun's sign for long stretches of the year.

conditions_and_qualifications: Aspect = whole-sign graha drishti (Jupiter 5/7/9, Saturn 3/7/10, Rahu 7 - project convention; Rahu's 7th falls on Ketu's sign); conjunction = same sign. Venus and Mercury can only conjoin the Sun (they never get far enough to aspect it).

Conflict: TA p.154 S34 A3 and the 2026 document's gold-bullish #2 make the Sun in Libra with/aspected by malefics (Saturn, Mars, Rahu) BULLISH for gold, and TA S34 A10 says a malefic aspect makes the Sun's rally stars MORE bullish; TA S34 B1 makes a benefic with the Sun on Anuradha bearish. Both sources are shown.
Mercury is never more than ~28 deg from the Sun, so it shares the Sun's sign for long stretches of the year.
events.calculation_method: Sidereal (Lahiri) whole sign of the body; window bounded by its ingresses. Waxing = Shukla paksha (elongation 0-180 deg). conditions_and_qualifications: Aspect = whole-sign graha drishti (Jupiter 5/7/9, Saturn 3/7/10, Rahu 7 - project convention; Rahu's 7th falls on Ketu's sign); conjunction = same sign. Venus and Mercury can only conjoin the Sun (they never get far enough to aspect it).

Mercury is never more than ~28 deg from the Sun, so it shares the Sun's sign for long stretches of the year.

events.event_title: Panchak (Moon in Dhanishta 3rd pada to Revati)
events.planetary_condition: At start: Moon 23.34 deg Capricorn (Dhanishta pada 1; D9 Leo), 11.811 deg/day | At end: Moon 29.99 deg Pisces (Revati pada 4; D9 Pisces), 12.568 deg/day | Computed: start weekday NY: Thursday; start ghadi after sunrise: 48.0; end ghadi after sunrise: 21.5; indra vaidhriti vyatipata inside: ['Vyatipata']; results: ['Starts Sun/Tue/Thu/Sat - Bullish (#7)', 'Starts & ends at other times - Bearish for that fortnight (#5)', 'Vyatipata yoga on Panchak days - high Bullish (#8)']; note vs existing: Condition stated in the PDF differs from / is broader than existing rule b056_aindra_vaidhriti_or_vyatipata_yoga_in_panchak; this window is not one of its rows.
events.astrological_rule: Moon from 0deg Aquarius (Dhanishta pada 3) to the end of Revati.
events.source_interpretation: Panchak (Moon in Dhanishta 3rd pada to Revati): #6 starts Mon/Wed/Fri Bearish; #7 Sun/Tue/Thu/Sat Bullish; #3 starts & ends 50 ghadi after sunrise Bullish for one year; #4 45 ghadi Bullish for the month; #5 other times Bearish for that fortnight; #8 Indra, Vaidhrati or Vyatipat yog on Panchak days high Bullish
events.financial_market_significance: #6 starts Mon/Wed/Fri Bearish; #7 Sun/Tue/Thu/Sat Bullish; #3 starts & ends 50 ghadi after sunrise Bullish for one year; #4 45 ghadi Bullish for the month; #5 other times Bearish for that fortnight; #8 Indra, Vaidhrati or Vyatipat yog on Panchak days high Bullish -> General market (the sources write for Indian indices - NIFTY/Bank Nifty; no instrument named) (as the source states it; not a forecast)
conditions_and_qualifications: TA p.77 bottom NOTE: 1, 3 & 8 ARE HIGH PROBABLE, THE REST DEPEND ON MANY OTHER FACTORS.
Rules #1/#2 ('If all five Panchak Bullish/Bearish') are not computed: the book does not say what makes one Panchak day bullish.
events.calculation_method: Moon's sidereal longitude >= 293deg20'; ghadi counted from New York sunrise (1 day = 60 ghadi, 1 hour = 2.5 ghadi, TA p.77). || Swiss Ephemeris (pyswisseph, sepl/semo 18 files), sidereal Lahiri ayanamsha, mean lunar node, whole-sign relationships; condition sampled hourly and every boundary bisected to 30 seconds; times shown in New York local time (EST/EDT by IANA America/New_York) with IST alongside.

events.event_title: Bhadra (Vishti karana): loka and day/night effect
events.planetary_condition: At start: Moon 27.49 deg Capricorn (Dhanishta pada 2; D9 Virgo), 11.792 deg/day | At end: Moon 04.05 deg Aquarius (Dhanishta pada 4; D9 Scorpio), 11.778 deg/day | Computed: tithi: Shukla Chaturthi; moon sign at start: Capricorn; loka: Patal (hell) - no effect here, beneficial; type: Night Bhadra; mostly in NY daytime: False; day night rule: Night Bhadra in night time - Negative
events.astrological_rule: Each Vishti karana: Moon's sign at its start fixes the loka; Day Bhadra = Shukla 8/15, Krishna 7/14; Night Bhadra = Shukla 4/11, Krishna 3/10.
events.source_interpretation: Bhadra (Vishti karana): loka and day/night effect: Earth (Cancer, Leo, Aquarius, Pisces) - negative & sentimental Bearish; heaven/hell - no effect, beneficial. Day Bhadra in day time / night Bhadra in night time - Negative; day Bhadra in night / night Bhadra in day - Positive
events.financial_market_significance: Earth (Cancer, Leo, Aquarius, Pisces) - negative & sentimental Bearish; heaven/hell - no effect, beneficial. Day Bhadra in day time / night Bhadra in night time - Negative; day Bhadra in night / night Bhadra in day - Positive -> General market (the sources write for Indian indices - NIFTY/Bank Nifty; no instrument named) (as the source states it; not a forecast)
conditions_and_qualifications: 'Starts in' read as the Moon's sign at the Bhadra's start.
Day/night judged at New York; Indian timing differs by ~10 h.
source_reference: TA p.121-122 [printed 91-92] Section 28 'Bhadra & its effect' (Muhurta Chintamani)
events.calculation_method: Vishti karana spans from the astronomy layer (6deg elongation steps); Moon sign at the start; share of the window between New York sunrise and sunset (>= 50% = day time). || Swiss Ephemeris (pyswisseph, sepl/semo 18 files), sidereal Lahiri ayanamsha, mean lunar node, whole-sign relationships; condition sampled hourly and every boundary bisected to 30 seconds; times shown in New York local time (EST/EDT by IANA America/New_York) with IST alongside.
